dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Progressive, symmetrical narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle, terminating in a sharp angular convergence.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with minor asymmetrical bulges observed on the left lateral edge relative to the right.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white to off-white skin tone; high median pixel intensity consistent with a depigmented adult phenotype.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse grey mottling across the dorsal surface, with subtle concentrations visible on the left flank.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient boundaries between white and light-grey pigmented areas with no sharp delineation.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of light-colored linear marks and small punctate spots localized along the posterior half of the dorsal ridge.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Subtle topological disruptions along the central dorsal axis appearing as a sequence of small, shallow notches.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Healed linear rake marks or abrasions visible along the central and posterior dorsal ridge.
